from pathlib import Path
p=Path(sys.argv[1])/'scripts'/'layout_gate.py'

m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)
fd,tmp=tempfile.mkstemp(suffix='.mp4'); os.write(fd,b'\x00'*64); os.close(fd)
info=m._inspect_mp4(Path(tmp)); os.unlink(tmp)
has=lambda n: hasattr(m,n)
ok=(info.get('ok') is False and has('_inspect_mp4')
    and has('_validate_native_review_record'))
print(json.dumps({'bytes':p.stat().st_size,'fake_mp4':info,
                  'validators':[n for n in ('_inspect_mp4',
                     '_validate_native_review_record') if has(n)],'ok':ok}))
sys.exit(0 if ok else 3)
